{"code":"def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8]
 if len(pts)<1:return out
 # determine diagonal direction from ordered endpoints, and extend from endpoint farthest from wall toward wall
 pts.sort()
 # identify wall 2 orientation
 tw=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
 horizontal=len({r for r,c in tw})<len({c for r,c in tw}) if tw else False
 if horizontal:
  end=min(pts) # upper endpoint, proceed down-right/down-left according segment
  if len(pts)>1: dr=pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]; dr=1 if dr>0 else -1; dc=1 if dc>0 else -1
  else: dr,dc=1,1
 else:
  end=min(pts) # upper endpoint
  if len(pts)>1: dr=pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]; dr=-1 if dr>0 else 1; dc=-1 if dc>0 else 1
  else: dr,dc=-1,1
 r,c=end
 for _ in range(h*w*2):
  r+=dr;c+=dc
  if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w): break
  if grid[r][c]==2: break
  if grid[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=3
 return out"}
